title: Receptionist
description:
Summary:
Receptionist needed for a busy housing office located in Athens, Ohio. Will be supporting the office by answering phones, transferring calls, greeting walk-ins, doing data entry of tenant information, and general customer service support work. Other office-related projects will be assigned during downtime.

This is a temporary position, hiring ASAP, and lasting two to three months. The hours will be 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday. Pay is $14 per hour.

Qualifications:
  • Must have at least one year of related experience.
  • Must have a helpful customer service attitude.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Computer fluency and strong data entry skills with accuracy.

title: General Laborer
description:
Summary:
General laborer needed for a Southeast Ohio contractor, doing jobs mostly in Gallia, Jackson, and Vinton Counties in Ohio and occasionally into Point Pleasant, West Virginia. Will be assisting with a variety of home improvement and build projects throughout the Southeast Ohio area. A day could consist of framing, dry walling, light plumbing/electrical work, and general laborer projects as needed.

This is a direct-hire, full-time position, hiring immediately. The schedule can vary based on customer/job site, but is either 7 a.m. to 4 p.m. or 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday. Pay is competitive and commensurate with experience with paid vacation time. Tools are provided by the company.

Qualifications:
  • Must have at least one year of relevant experience.
  • Must have a valid driver's license and a clean record to operate company vehicles.
  • Must understand and be able to perform basic general labor.
  • Must know how to handle basic tools and read a tape measure.
  • Must be physically capable of heavy lifting, not afraid of heights, and be comfortable with sometimes going into confined spaces like attics and crawl spaces.
This company operates a drug-free workplace program.
